verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention settings, retention periods, or delete endpoints for uploaded files, results, or checkpoints. File storage (docs-37) and saved checkpoints (docs-29) show that data is kept, but not that users can control or delete it. On-prem deployment and BAA/DPA offerings are adjacent privacy measures, not user-facing retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
